title.value: Development of a Ranking Procedure for Energy Performance Evaluation of Buildings based on Occupant Behavior
title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly stated at the beginning of the document, reflecting the main focus of the study.
title.quote: Development of a Ranking Procedure for Energy Performance Evaluation of Buildings based on Occupant Behavior

extractions.description: This paper presents a methodology to evaluate and rank building energy performance based on occupant behavior using data-mining techniques. The methodology focuses on identifying the impact of occupants on energy consumption and suggesting strategies to reduce it. The study demonstrates the application on monitored residential buildings in Japan, aiming to improve buildings’ energy-saving potential by understanding occupant behavior.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on reducing energy consumption in buildings by analyzing occupant behavior, which aligns with efforts in climate change mitigation by enhancing energy efficiency.
primary_category.quote: Occupants could affect the energy consumption of a building to great extents even if all systems and equipment...work perfectly.

secondary_categories.justification: No secondary category applied, as the primary category already best encapsulates the paper’s focus on energy efficiency within buildings.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper directly addresses enhancing energy efficiency by developing a method to evaluate and improve how occupant behavior affects energy consumption in buildings.
primary_sub_category.quote: This shows the necessity of energy consumption manipulation in buildings for a sustainable future...occupant behavior as an important contributor that can increase the energy efficiency of buildings.

applications.justification: The paper’s methodology is applicable for implementation in building energy management systems, focusing on occupant behavior to improve energy efficiency.
applications.quote: It also provides diverse and prioritized strategies to help occupants manage their energy consumption by revealing the building energy end-use patterns.

new_primary_category.justification: The existing category 'Climate Change Mitigation' sufficiently covers the paper’s focus on improving energy efficiency in buildings through better occupant behavior management.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-category 'Energy Efficiency in Buildings' adequately corresponds to the subject matter of the paper, thus no new sub-category is proposed.
